name: vscode-deps-sync
description: PyCharm-style banner for unsatisfied package requirements: finds missing packages and version drift in uv.lock / pyproject.toml / requirements.txt, offers to fix them.

depsSync.checkOnFocus.description: Re-check when the window is focused (at most once a minute).

depsSync.checkOnSave.description: Re-check after saving pyproject.toml / uv.lock / requirements.txt.

depsSync.banner.description: Show a PyCharm-style notification banner when problems are found.

enumDescriptions: Targeted install of problem packages only (uv pip install / python -m pip install).
Run `uv sync` with the args from depsSync.uvSyncArgs (uv projects only; pip projects fall back to targeted).
depsSync.syncMode.description: How "Sync project" runs: a targeted install of problem packages, or a full `uv sync`.

depsSync.uvSyncArgs.description: Arguments for `uv sync` (used when depsSync.syncMode = uv-sync). Example: ["--all-groups", "--inexact"]. Note: without --inexact, uv sync may remove packages that are not in the sync set.
